name: AIOMetadata
description: AIOMetadata is a Stremio metadata addon that aggregates movie, series, and anime data from TMDB, TVDB, Fanart.tv, MyAnimeList/Jikan, AniList, Trakt, SimKL and others into one configurable catalog and metadata source, with per-user API keys, poster/art proxying, and background cache warming. This installs it with a local Redis cache and SQLite for config/auth storage; users bring their own provider API keys from the /configure dashboard.

default_credentials.password: No login by default. An ADMIN_KEY protecting the dashboard's admin endpoints is generated during installation, see /opt/aiometadata_data/.env

notes.text: No provider API keys are set by default. Add your own TMDB/TVDB/Fanart.tv/RPDB/etc. keys from the /configure page (per-user) or set the BUILT_IN_* variants in /opt/aiometadata_data/.env to fund keys for every user of this instance.

TMDB_API_KEY, TVDB_API_KEY, FANART_API_KEY, RPDB_API_KEY, MDBLIST_API_KEY and GEMINI_API_KEY (if set directly, not as BUILT_IN_*) are served in full to any visitor via /api/config so the configure page can prefill them - this is intentional upstream behavior, not a bug, but means those specific variables are not appropriate secrets on a shared instance.

Config/auth data lives in SQLite at /opt/aiometadata_data/db.sqlite by default; edit DATABASE_URI in the .env to point at PostgreSQL instead. Redis (local, password-protected) is used only as a cache - the app logs errors and keeps running if Redis is unreachable, it does not depend on it to start.

The public Jikan (MyAnimeList) API this addon uses by default is shut down by upstream on 2026-10-01. Self-host a Jikan instance and point JIKAN_API_BASE at it before that date to keep MAL/anime metadata working - see the project's self-hosted-jikan docs.
